summary:
Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo, but nothing was run: tests, the demo, and the widget were verified by reading the code and an ast.parse syntax check only, per the no-execution instruction.

Changes:
- src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new): Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs. Tabs owns state, key handling, and the bar-position animation watcher; TabsRenderable does the width layout and builds the label row and the underline bar. Click actions are attached as @click metadata and dispatched through the existing broker to action_range_clicked.
- src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py: new clickable_ranges input (before width); the bar yields a single Text object, with click spans appended last, and the zero-width early path skips them.
- src/textual/renderables/opacity.py: blended color is merged into each segment's existing style, preserving click metadata.
- docs/reference/tabs.md: single directive for textual.widgets.tabs.Tabs.
- sandbox/tabs_demo.py and sandbox/tabs_demo.css: optional demo.
- tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py: new cases appended; existing tests untouched.
- tests/widgets/test_tabs.py and tests/widgets/__init__.py (new).

Choices made where the spec was open:
- The layout resolver was not changed; it already has size, min_size (default 1), and fraction (default 1) on its edge protocol.
- Tabs sets can_focus = True so it receives key events.
- For duplicate names, the bar position (a full-list index) is mapped to the displayed tab with that name, so the underline sits under the displayed active tab.
- First-character search only considers single-character keys.
- Search skips any tab whose name equals the active name.
- Tabs takes only the constructor parameters the spec lists (no name or id).

Known limitation: a tab with an empty label gets a label edge of size 0, which the shared resolver treats as flexible, so it takes at least one cell. Fixing this would mean changing the resolver's size-or-None rule, which I left alone so existing callers keep their results.

Not done: no mkdocs nav entry was added (the config has no nav section for the reference pages).
